caption: The drawing displays a detailed, technical illustration of an ornate chair in several views and diagrams. The primary color of the drawing is a light beige background with dark, precise ink lines and some shaded areas for depth, giving the appearance of monochrome technical rendering. In the upper left, a frontal view of the chair is shown, featuring a rounded, intricately carved backrest with a button-tufted upholstered center, detailed scrollwork, and a cushioned seat. Beneath the seat, the front apron of the chair is also heavily decorated, and the legs are cabriole style with ornamental carvings. Directly to the right, a side view is presented, showing the continuous decorative carving along the backrest and base, as well as the profile of the padded seat and the shape of the legs. Below these main views, there is a simplified plan view of the seat base labeled "PLAN," indicating the overall shape and attachment points. To the right of the plan, there is a small circular technical detail labeled "DETAIL OF BACK PROTECTOR," with annotations pointing to parts labeled "COVER MATERIAL," "STUFFED," and "BRASS," illustrating a cross-section of some seat feature. At the bottom left, the name "KURT MELZER" appears, suggesting the creator or designer of the drawing. All elements are precisely rendered with fine lines; no colors aside from shades of gray and the beige paper are present. The scale noted below the chair views is "Scale: 1" = 2"."
title: Hoopskirt chair
